scares.description: A loud thud hits the door just as Jimmy approaches.
A fox suddenly bursts out of a ruined house with a sharp shriek.
The silence is broken by the sudden caw of a crow.
A hanging man suddenly screams and thrashes, revealing he is infected.
An infected slams violently against the cage where the Swedish soldiers are hiding.
The soldiers turn toward a noise, and one is instantly ambushed by the alpha infected.
An infected silently appears behind Isla in a flower field.
A group of mice suddenly scurries out from under the train.
An infected woman abruptly turns and screams directly at Isla.
An infected woman who has just given birth shrieks and lunges at Isla.
The alpha infected’s arm shoots through a grate and grabs Doctor Kelson.
